in_game_description: Briefly increase your ship's top speed. The Linear Boost is the cheapest booster on the market, but also the least reliable.
mechanics_text: Boosters are activated by pressing an upwards-turned fast-forward button at the bottom of the HUD.
After the boost has been used, a certain amount of time must pass before it can be used again, indicated by the button fading.
Effect 60% = speed increase of 60% above base speed (Keith's base ~450 km/h → 720 km/h with Linear Boost).
Loading speed 8000ms = 8 second recharge time before next use.
version_notes: Verification item: tech_level=4, effect_pct=60, effect_multiplier=1.6, duration_ms=3000, loading_speed_ms=8000. All confirmed from individual wiki page. The 'Effect' row = speed boost percentage, 'Loading speed' = recharge time, 'Boost duration' = active time.
